title: Language, Not Code Abstraction: Natural-language Training Shapes Brain-aligned Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2611.09027v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code-trained language models produce positive brain scores, which raises the question of whether abstract structure learned from programming languages can substitute for natural-language training. We trained 25 GPT-2-small models on TinyStories, Python, C functions, x86-64 assembly, and the corresponding machine code, and scored them using a shared tokenizer and encoding procedure against matched random-weight models. On Pereira-243 and Tuckute2024, TinyStories exceeds the mean of the four code models by $\Delta r = 0.053$ and $0.059$ (Holm-corrected $p<0.001$), while code training leaves alignment near the random-weight level. The language advantage is benchmark-specific: Blank2014 shows no corrected language-code difference, and Fedorenko2016 shows no language benefit. translated_title: 语言而非代码抽象：自然语言训练塑造与大脑对齐的几何结构
translated_abstract: 在代码上训练的语言模型能够产生正向的脑评分，这引出了一个疑问：从编程语言中学到的抽象结构能否替代自然语言训练？研究者在TinyStories、Python、C函数、x86-64汇编以及相应的机器代码上训练了25个GPT-2-small模型，并使用共享的分词器与编码流程，将其与匹配的随机权重模型进行对比评分。在Pereira-243和Tuckute2024数据集上，TinyStories模型超过四个代码模型的平均值，Δr分别为0.053和0.059（经Holm校正的p<0.001），而代码训练使模型对齐程度停留在接近随机权重的水平。语言优势具有基准依赖性：Blank2014未显示经校正后的语言-代码差异，Fedorenko2016也未显示语言带来的优势。几何结构与Pereira-243上的编码结果一致：TinyStories种子模型收敛于最相似的表征，且其与神经不相似性的免拟合对应关系……
tldr: 研究通过对25个GPT-2模型的对照实验证明，只有自然语言训练才能塑造与大脑对齐的表征几何，代码训练无法替代自然语言训练在神经对齐中的作用。
en_tdlr: Natural-language training—not abstract structure learned from code—is what shapes brain-aligned geometry in language models, as code-trained models fail to exceed random-weight levels of neural alignment.
